arms.P_Q: section 8's ratio-alone arm refitted (first 4 ratio scores, unscaled) to record each fold's C; gate: equals ratio_slices.npz's Q arm for every seed
arms.Z_Q: the same scores with a StandardScaler fitted on the outer training fold

indicator: share of fitted folds whose chosen C is the grid's top (1e4)
intervals: paired bootstrap over slides of seed-averaged per-slide values, shared indices default_rng(12345).integers(0, 123, (4000, 123)); scaling: Z_Q - P_Q (accuracy), scaling_ll: P_Q - Z_Q (log-loss); alone_chance: Z_Q - chance; alone_ll: prevalence - Z_Q (log-loss)
